intent: Make every scheduled pr-ci-health invocation report-only, retain healing only behind explicit workflow_dispatch authority, bind rebase to one positive-integer PR number, and keep the operator-facing mechanical-backstop contract synchronized with those executable boundaries.

negative_controls.name: weakening-manual-rebase-event-guards-is-caught
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; p=Path('.github/workflows/pr-ci-health.yml'); t=p.read_text(); old=\"if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && env.MODE == 'rebase'\"; assert old in t; p.write_text(t.replace(old,\"if: env.MODE == 'rebase'\")); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_pr_ci_health_triggers.py::test_cron_cannot_reach_any_rebase_mutation_step'],check=False); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

negative_controls.name: removing-the-single-pr-selector-is-caught
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; p=Path('.github/workflows/pr-ci-health.yml'); t=p.read_text(); old=' | select(.number == $target_pr)'; assert old in t; p.write_text(t.replace(old,'')); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_pr_ci_health_triggers.py::test_manual_rebase_is_bound_to_one_explicit_pr_number'],check=False); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

commit.message: fix(ci): make scheduled PR health report-only

interface_mismatches: The workflow's scheduled event currently resolves MODE to all, and both the push-authority step and backlog-wide rebase step accept MODE=all; removing the push-to-main trigger reduced wave frequency but left cron with mutation authority.
docs/governance/PR_QUALITY_GATES.md describes hourly rerun and rebase healing, so its operator contract would remain stale after the executable workflow becomes report-only.
honest_blockers: The local proof parses and adversarially mutates the workflow and binds the operator guide to that executable contract; it does not claim a hosted schedule or workflow_dispatch run occurred.
The workflow is manually disabled as temporary containment outside this packet. This packet does not re-enable it or mutate GitHub state.
A targeted rebase still requires a configured credential that passes the existing repository push-authority probe; this packet neither provisions nor exposes that secret.
Hosted exact-head CI, independent review, and human merge authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the workflow, operator-guide update, both trigger-contract test files, and this packet together. Reverting restores scheduled MODE=all, backlog-wide cron rebase authority, and the former hourly-healing documentation.
